about: Demon's Souls (BLUS30443, BLES00932, and BCJS30022 and BCAS20071 at 1.04): the SPU programs inside the decrypted EBOOT.ELF,
for scripts/build_spu.py --eboot. Images: each embedded SPU ELF by its name (index and file offset in
the US EBOOT), its size and its FNV-1a-64 fingerprint (build_spu.py img_size and fnv, the runtime's
workload key); an image is found by its fingerprint, so the other discs' EBOOTs, at other offsets, get the
same names. Jobs: the SPURS job binaries, raw blobs cut at a virtual address (vaddr, or vaddr_eu, vaddr_jp, vaddr_asia in the
other EBOOTs), with size and fingerprint. Addresses, sizes and hashes only; no bytes of the game.
